_readme: Single source of truth for the dashboard. Values are per company, keyed by company name. Money in USD millions unless the metric name says otherwise. Percentages and multiples are stored as display strings (e.g. '48.7%', '3.2x'); use 'N/A' or '—' when not available. See AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md before editing.

Equinix.Revenue ($M): TTM Sep 2026 = FY2025 + 9M 2026 − 9M 2025: 9,217 + 7,640 − 6,797 = 10,060 (FY25 10-K income statement; Q3-26 10-Q / Q3-26 earnings release income statement).
Equinix.EBITDA ($M): Company-reported adjusted EBITDA. TTM = FY2025 + 9M 2026 − 9M 2025: 4,530 + 3,962 − 3,344 = 5,148 (FY25 from Q4-25 earnings release Ex.99.1 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1101239/000110123926000030/february112026pressrelease-.htm; 9M figures from Q3-26 earnings release non-GAAP reconciliation).
Equinix.PAT ($M): Net income (total, incl. NCI). TTM = 1,348 + 1,381 − 1,084 = 1,645 (FY25 10-K; Q3-26 10-Q). Attributable to common stockholders would be 1,350 + 1,383 − 1,085 = 1,648.
Equinix.Net Debt ($M): Balance sheet at 30 Sep 2026: finance lease liabilities 182 + 2,196, mortgage & loans 6 + 13, senior notes 1,665 + 20,963 = 25,025 carrying value; less cash & cash equivalents 2,362 = 22,663. Finance leases included because Equinix's own debt summary ('Total debt principal outstanding' 25,217) includes them. Equinix does not publish a $ net-debt figure in the release.
Equinix.G&A costs ($M): 'General and administrative' income-statement line (incl. D&A and SBC, same basis as old FY24 value 1,766). TTM = 1,840 + 1,355 − 1,359 = 1,836 (FY25 10-K; Q3-26 10-Q).
Equinix.Total employees: Total headcount at 30 Sep 2026 (Americas 6,021 + EMEA 4,768 + APAC 3,253), shown under the balance sheet in the Q3-26 earnings release. (Dec 2025: 13,716 per FY25 10-K.)
Equinix.Capex/MW: Purchases of other property, plant and equipment (cash flow). TTM = 4,311 + 4,392 − 2,875 = 5,828 (FY25 10-K; Q3-26 10-Q). Excludes real estate acquisitions (FY25 994; 9M26 234; 9M25 391), consistent with old Last FY capex 4,311. ÷ 1900 MW.
Equinix.FCF/MW: FY2025 operating cash flow 3,911 − purchases of other PP&E 4,311 = −400 (FY25 10-K cash flow statement). ÷ 1900 MW.

Digital Realty.EBITDA ($M): Company-reported Adjusted EBITDA, sum of last 4 quarters (Q3-26 supplement p.27 reconciliation): 856.8 (Q4-25) + 920.3 (Q1-26) + 977.6 (Q2-26) + 977.7 (Q3-26) = 3,732.4. Q2-26 excludes a $187.9M net promote per DLR's definition.
Digital Realty.PAT ($M): Net income (total, before NCI and preferred dividends; same basis as old FY24 588). TTM = 1,313.2 + 826.0 − 1,217.1 = 922.1 (FY25 10-K; Q3-26 10-Q). Net income available to common: 88.5 + 169.1 + 443.1 + 185.2 = 885.8.
Digital Realty.Net Debt ($M): Balance sheet 30 Sep 2026 (supplement p.15 / 10-Q): revolver 1,640.5 + term loans 424.4 + senior notes 15,809.5 + secured & other 1,620.3 = 19,494.6 total debt carrying value; less cash & cash equivalents 802.9 = 18,691.7. DLR does not publish a $ net-debt figure; its 5.2x net debt/Adj. EBITDA ratio also adds finance leases and pro-rata JV debt net of JV cash (implied ≈ 5.2 × 977.7 × 4 ≈ 20,300).
Digital Realty.G&A costs ($M): 'General and administrative' income-statement line. TTM = 565.5 + 485.7 − 401.3 = 650.0 (FY25 10-K; Q3-26 10-Q). Same line as old FY24 value 480.0.
Digital Realty.Installed IT capacity (MW): Supplement p.3: 'portfolio is comprised of approximately 3.2 gigawatts of IT capacity' at 30 Sep 2026 (incl. unconsolidated JVs, 100% share); results presentation p.4 '~3 GW in-place IT capacity'.
Digital Realty.Pipeline capacity (MW): Data center construction IT capacity under construction, total 1,464 MW (100% share) in Development Lifecycle table, supplement p.23, at 30 Sep 2026 (Americas 1,111 + EMEA 211 + APAC 142); matches meaning of old 1,402. Separately ~9.8 GW buildable incl. land/shell.
Digital Realty.Last FY capex ($M): FY2025 'Improvements to investments in real estate', FY25 10-K cash flow statement (FY2024 was 2,831.7).
Digital Realty.Next FY capex ($M): FY2026 outlook as of 29 Oct 2026 (supplement p.10): development capex net of partner contributions 4,250–4,750 + enhancements/other non-recurring 30–35 + recurring capex & capitalized leasing 400–425 = 4,680–5,210; midpoint 4,945. Development-only midpoint 4,500.
Digital Realty.Customer concentration: Top 20 customers table, supplement p.21: largest customer (Fortune 50 software company) = 10.6% of annualized recurring revenue at 30 Sep 2026 (FY25 10-K: 11.7% at Dec 2025).
Digital Realty.Capex/MW: 'Improvements to investments in real estate' (cash flow). TTM = 3,181.2 + 3,166.2 − 2,179.0 = 4,168.4 (FY25 10-K; Q3-26 10-Q). Excludes 9M26 acquisitions of 2,944.0 and JV investments. ÷ 3200 MW.
Digital Realty.FCF/MW: FY2025 net cash from operating activities 2,412.1 − improvements to investments in real estate 3,181.2 = −769.0 (FY25 10-K cash flow statement). ÷ 3200 MW.

CoreWeave.EBITDA ($M): Company-reported Adjusted EBITDA, TTM = FY2025 + 9M 2026 − 9M 2025: 3,093 + 4,923 − 2,197 = 5,819 (FY25 from Q4'25 earnings release reconciliation, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1769628/000176962826000094/coreweave4q25earningspress.htm; 9M figures from Q3'26 earnings release reconciliation).
CoreWeave.Net Debt ($M): At 30 Sep 2026 (10-Q balance sheet): recourse debt current 9,183 + non-recourse current 1,389 + recourse non-current 32,417 + non-recourse non-current 3,884 = 46,873 total borrowings, minus cash & cash equivalents 4,122 = 42,751. Excludes finance leases (296+353=649) and operating leases (668+18,029=18,697); CoreWeave does not report its own net-debt figure.
CoreWeave.G&A costs ($M): 'General and administrative' income-statement line. TTM = 651 + 530 − 501 = 680 (FY25 10-K; Sep-26 10-Q).
CoreWeave.Installed IT capacity (MW): Q3'26 earnings release highlights: 'Added more than 200 MWs of active power to reach over 1.7 GW' as of Q3 2026 (active power).
CoreWeave.Pipeline capacity (MW): Q3'26 earnings release: 'Grew total contracted power more than 900 MW to over 4.6 GW' (total contracted power, which includes active).
CoreWeave.Next FY capex ($M): Q3'26 earnings release Business Outlook: full-year 2026 capex now expected at $37–39 billion; midpoint 38,000.
CoreWeave.Customer concentration: 10-Q Note on revenue (customers ≥10% of revenue): 9M 2026 Customer A 33%, Customer B 26%; Q3 2026 B 30%, A 24%. Customers not named.
CoreWeave.Capex/MW: Purchases of property and equipment incl. capitalized internal-use software (cash flow). TTM = 10,309 + 23,558 − 6,249 = 27,618 (FY25 10-K; Sep-26 10-Q). ÷ 1700 MW.
CoreWeave.FCF/MW: FY2025 operating cash flow 3,058 − purchases of PP&E 10,309 = −7,251 (FY25 10-K cash-flow statement). ÷ 1700 MW.

Fermi.EBITDA ($M): Fermi does not report adjusted EBITDA. Proxy = loss from operations (no D&A: the 10-Q says no depreciable PP&E was in service and no depreciation was recognised). TTM Sep 2026 = FY2025 + 9M 2026 − 9M 2025: -177.8 + -335.2 − (-43.5) = -469.5 (FY25 10-K; Sep-26 10-Q). Same proxy as the old H1 2026 value (-193 = H1 2026 operating loss).
Fermi.PAT ($M): Net loss (total, no NCI). TTM = FY2025 + 9M 2026 − 9M 2025 (Jan 10–Sep 30, 2025 inception period): -486.4 + -356.1 − (-353.2) = -489.3. Cross-check: it equals the 30 Sep 2026 accumulated deficit of 489.3 (deficit counted from the Oct 2025 conversion).
Fermi.Net Debt ($M): At 30 Sep 2026, same method as the old 445 (Jun-26: 536.9 principal − 62.5 cash − 29.2 restricted = 445.2): total debt principal 999.9 (Note 5: turbine warehouse 444.9 + convertible notes 431.3 + HV equipment 91.5 + turbine warehouse II 32.3) − cash 286.3 − restricted cash 29.2 = 684.4. Strict brief basis (Debt, net 958.4 − cash 286.3) = 672.0. Fermi reports no net-debt figure of its own. No finance leases.
Fermi.G&A costs ($M): General and administrative line. TTM = 177.8 + 335.2 − 43.5 = 469.5 (FY25 10-K; Sep-26 10-Q). Includes 9M 2026 stock comp of 184.5 and 21.5 of advisory fees paid in shares.
Fermi.Next FY capex ($M): 10-Q Liquidity: 'incremental capital expenditures we will incur in the next twelve months will be approximately $2 to $3 billion', subject to lease execution. Value is the midpoint. The Q2 10-Q said ~$2 billion (the old 2000).
Fermi.Customer concentration: 10-Q Note 9 (Subsequent Events): TensorWave lease terminated 10 Nov 2026 after the closing date passed; 10 Nov 2026 non-binding LOI with an investment-grade hyperscaler for ~600 MW of powered land, plus a $200M prepayment agreement and a $15M early-works agreement.
Fermi.Capex/MW: Investments in property, plant and equipment (cash flow). TTM = FY2025 569.3 + 9M 2026 759.5 − 9M 2025 96.3 = 1,232.5. 9M 2025 is the comparative as restated in the Sep-26 10-Q; the original Q3-25 10-Q showed 89.0, which would give 1,239.8. ÷ 222 MW.
Fermi.FCF/MW: FY2025 operating cash flow -34.2 − PP&E investments 569.3 = -603.5 (FY25 10-K cash flow statement). The old FCF/MW (-3.07 × 222 = -682) matched H1 2026 (-56.0 − 626.2 = -682.2), not FY2025. ÷ 222 MW.

NextDC.Revenue ($M): FY26 (year to 30 Jun 2026) data centre revenue A$496,492k = A$496.5m (Annual Report, Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income; 'Total revenue' in results release). Net revenue (less direct costs) = A$405.0m. AUD. Converted A$496.5m × 0.6804 (RBA F11 rate, 13 Nov 2026) = US$337.8m.
NextDC.EBITDA ($M): FY26 Underlying EBITDA A$248.8m (FY26 Results Presentation p.8 and reconciliation p.34; results release table). AUD. FY25 comparative 216.7. Converted A$248.8m × 0.6804 (RBA F11 rate, 13 Nov 2026) = US$169.3m.
NextDC.PAT ($M): FY26 statutory profit after tax A$82,063k = A$82.1m, all attributable to owners (Annual Report income statement). AUD. Converted A$82.1m × 0.6804 (RBA F11 rate, 13 Nov 2026) = US$55.9m.
NextDC.Net Debt ($M): At 30 Jun 2026: non-current borrowings A$3,276.5m (no current borrowings) - cash A$876.0m = A$2,400.5m; lease liabilities excluded. Company-reported net debt: A$751m excl. subordinated capital, or A$2,466m incl. subordinated capital (both incl. derivatives; Results Presentation p.11). Chose balance-sheet arithmetic. AUD. Converted A$2,400.5m × 0.6804 (RBA F11 rate, 13 Nov 2026) = US$1,633.3m.
NextDC.G&A costs ($M): FY26 'Corporate costs' A$77.4m (Results Presentation P&L summary p.8). Old value 41 (USD) matches FY25 corporate costs A$66.3m x ~0.62. AUD. Converted A$77.4m × 0.6804 (RBA F11 rate, 13 Nov 2026) = US$52.7m.
NextDC.Installed IT capacity (MW): Built capacity 287.9MW at 30 Jun 2026 (results release table; AR p.17). Old 208 = FY25 built capacity 207.9MW.
NextDC.Pipeline capacity (MW): Forward Order Book 565.1MW at 30 Jun 2026 (pro forma, as disclosed 21 Jul 2026) = contracted utilisation 740.1MW - billing utilisation 175.0MW; binding contracts only. FY25 equivalent was 133.9MW (old value 131.5 closest to this measure). Alternatives: 537MW under development in progress + 240MW+ in plan.
NextDC.Last FY capex ($M): Same as period capex (FY26 is latest completed FY): A$2,076.1m PP&E + A$954.6m investment properties. Company-reported FY26 capex A$3,397m. AUD. Converted A$3,030.7m × 0.6804 (RBA F11 rate, 13 Nov 2026) = US$2,062.1m.
NextDC.Next FY capex ($M): FY27 capex guidance revised 21 Oct 2026 to A$4,500-5,000m (from A$5,250-5,750m on 27 Aug 2026); midpoint A$4,750m. Includes ~A$500m reimbursable customer fitout and ~A$230m capitalised interest. AUD. Converted A$4,750.0m × 0.6804 (RBA F11 rate, 13 Nov 2026) = US$3,231.9m.
NextDC.Customer concentration: FY26 two customers contributed A$161.1m (33%) and A$87.2m (18%) of total revenue (AR financial risk note; FY25: 29% + 18% = 47%).
NextDC.Capex/MW: FY26 cash flow: payments for PP&E A$2,076.1m + payments for investment properties A$954.6m (M3/S4/M5 data-centre sites reclassified under AASB 140) = A$3,030.7m. PP&E only = A$2,076.1m; company-reported capex (accrual) = A$3,397m. AUD. ÷ 287.9 MW.
NextDC.FCF/MW: FY26 net cash from operating activities A$99.9m - (PP&E A$2,076.1m + investment properties A$954.6m) = -A$2,930.8m. PP&E-only basis: -A$1,976.3m. AUD. ÷ 287.9 MW.

Applied Digital.Revenue ($M): TTM Aug 2026 = FY2026 + Q1 FY27 - Q1 FY26 total revenue: 611.3 + 341.9 - 80.9 = 872.3 (FY26 10-K income statement; Aug-26 10-Q income statement, whose Aug-25 comparative is on the same basis as the 10-K, i.e. cloud/ChronoScale in continuing ops, Ekso in discontinued ops).
Applied Digital.EBITDA ($M): Company Adjusted EBITDA (excludes ChronoScale): FY2026 107.2 (FY26 10-K MD&A reconciliation) + Q1 FY27 64.4 - Q1 FY26 0.5 (Q1 FY27 earnings release reconciliation) = 171.1.
Applied Digital.PAT ($M): Net loss attributable to common stockholders (basis of old -250 value): FY26 -250.3 + Q1 FY27 -237.1 - Q1 FY26 -18.5 = -468.8. Total consolidated net loss TTM would be -184.3 - 184.1 + 16.9 = -351.5.
Applied Digital.Net Debt ($M): At 31 Aug 2026: current debt 112.6 + long-term debt 6,263.9 = 6,376.6 less cash & cash equivalents 2,949.9 = 3,426.7 (excludes restricted cash 313.4, finance leases 45.9, operating leases 60.9). Company does not report a net-debt figure.
Applied Digital.G&A costs ($M): Selling, general and administrative (only SG&A reported; old 332.1 = FY26 SG&A): 332.1 + 114.7 - 29.5 = 417.3.
Applied Digital.Installed IT capacity (MW): Old 386 = 100 MW HPC (Polaris Forge 1 Bldg 1) + 286 MW crypto hosting (Jamestown 106 + Ellendale 180). Now: Polaris Forge 1 250 MW live after second 75 MW phase of Bldg 2 RFS on 1 Oct 2026 + 286 MW = 536 (Q1 FY27 earnings release, 7 Oct 2026). At 31 Aug 2026 balance-sheet date it was 175 + 286 = 461.
Applied Digital.Customer concentration: Q1 FY27 (3 months to 31 Aug 2026): Customer A 56%, B 21%, C 11% of revenue (10-Q revenue concentration). FY2026: Customer A 59% (FY26 10-K).
Applied Digital.Capex/MW: Cash-flow 'Purchases of property and equipment and other assets': FY26 2,865.8 + Q1 FY27 2,074.7 - Q1 FY26 249.9 = 4,690.5. ÷ 536 MW.
Applied Digital.FCF/MW: FY2026: operating cash flow 89.7 - purchases of property and equipment and other assets 2,865.8 = -2,776.1 (FY26 10-K cash-flow statement). Old FCF/MW -7.19 x 386 implies the same ~-2,775. ÷ 536 MW.

IREN.Revenue ($M): TTM Sep 2026 = FY2026 + Q1 FY27 - Q1 FY26 total revenue: 707.0 + 228 - 240 = 695.0 (FY26 10-K; Sep-26 10-Q, reported in $ millions).
IREN.EBITDA ($M): Company Adjusted EBITDA: FY2026 245.7 (FY26 10-K reconciliation; matches old 246) + Q1 FY27 66 - Q1 FY26 92 (10-Q reconciliation) = 219.7. FY26 definition change (excl. debt conversion inducement) had no effect on prior periods.
IREN.PAT ($M): Net income (loss) (no NCI): FY26 -702.6 + Q1 FY27 -263 - Q1 FY26 +385 = -1,350.6. Q1 FY26 included +665 unrealized gain on financial instruments.
IREN.Net Debt ($M): At 30 Sep 2026: debt current 950 + non-current 8,947 = 9,897 less cash & cash equivalents 3,522 = 6,375 (excludes restricted cash 2,256, finance leases 311 and operating leases 7). Company reports no net-debt figure.
IREN.G&A costs ($M): Selling, general and administrative expenses (old 449.1 = FY26 SG&A): 449.1 + 217 - 138 = 528.1. Excludes new R&D line (7 in Q1 FY27).
IREN.Next FY capex ($M): Q1 FY27 release: '$15 billion remaining planned FY27 capex' (from 30 Sep 2026, data centers + GPUs). Q1 FY27 actual cash capex was ~4,889 (PP&E 2,131 + hardware 2,693 + intangibles 65), so full-year implied ~20bn, but no full-year number is stated.
IREN.Customer concentration: Q1 FY27: three largest customers 28%, 24%, 18% of total revenue (10-Q Note 4 / MD&A).
IREN.Capex/MW: Same basis as old FY26 capex 4,451 (PP&E net of hardware + computer hardware + intangibles + ROU deposits): FY26 4,450.8 + Q1 FY27 (2,131 + 2,693 + 65) - Q1 FY26 (180 + 100) = 9,059.8. PP&E + hardware only = 8,877.1. ÷ 810 MW.
IREN.FCF/MW: FY2026: net cash from operating activities 2,100.4 - payments for PP&E 2,998.0 - payments for computer hardware 1,335.1 = -2,232.7 (same basis as old FY25 FCF/MW: 245.9 - 573.5 - 799.2 = -1,126.7 = -1.39 x 810). OCF inflated by 1,841.7 deferred revenue (customer prepayments). ÷ 810 MW.

Hut 8.Revenue ($M): TTM Sep 2026 = FY2025 + 9M 2026 − 9M 2025: 235.1 + 217.0 − 146.6 = 305.5 (FY25 10-K/FY release; Sep-26 10-Q income statement).
Hut 8.EBITDA ($M): Uses the FY2025 definition, now called 'Adjusted EBITDA, inclusive of digital assets mark-to-market'. TTM = FY2025 -135.4 + 9M 2026 5.2 − 9M 2025 212.5 = -342.7 (FY25 release reconciliation; Sep-26 10-Q MD&A reconciliation). The 9M 2025 inclusive figure (212.5) matches FY25 −135.4 minus Q4 −347.8, so the measure is the same. On the new headline definition (ex digital-asset MTM) 9M 2026 = 40.7 and 9M 2025 = 29.4, but FY2025/Q4 2025 have not been recast, so a TTM on that basis cannot be built.
Hut 8.PAT ($M): Net income attributable to Hut 8 Corp. (same basis as the old -226 = FY25 attributable -226.1). TTM = -226.1 + -239.0 − 53.5 = -518.7. Total net loss incl. NCI: -248.0 + -240.8 − 53.8 = -542.6.
Hut 8.Net Debt ($M): At 30 Sep 2026: loans, notes payable & other financial liabilities 226.1 current + 7,405.4 non-current = 7,631.5 (mainly the $3.25B River Bend and $4.25B Beacon Point non-recourse project notes plus the $200M FalconX loan) − cash 156.9 = 7,474.6. Netting restricted cash & equivalents 3,556.0 and restricted short-term investments 2,838.5 (unspent project-bond proceeds held for construction and debt service) gives 1,080.1. Hut 8 reports no net-debt figure. No finance leases (0).
Hut 8.G&A costs ($M): General and administrative expenses line. TTM = 122.8 + 257.4 − 77.1 = 303.1 (same line as the old 122.8 = FY2025). 9M 2026 includes heavy stock compensation (166.9 for 9M).
Hut 8.Pipeline capacity (MW): Development pipeline at 30 Sep 2026 = 3,300 under diligence + 3,180 under exclusivity + 49 under development + 1,330 under construction = 7,859 MW. Same four categories as the old 8,500 (Dec-25: 5,185 + 1,755 + 1,230 + 330). Excludes the 1,000 MW River Bend ROFO expansion.
Hut 8.Last FY capex ($M): FY2025 'Purchases of property and equipment' 202.9 per FY25 10-K cash flow statement. The dashboard's 648 cannot be reproduced from cash-flow PP&E. It may include non-cash miner purchases (353.0) and deposits for future sites (162.7) or miners (14.0). Coordinator to decide whether to keep 648.
Hut 8.Customer concentration: 10-Q Note 11: River Bend is leased in its entirety to Fluidstack USA IV with a Google LLC financial backstop. The release says Beacon Point is fully commercialised with the Phase 1 tenant signing a second 352 MW lease. No revenue-% concentration is disclosed (contracted leases not yet producing revenue).
Hut 8.Capex/MW: Purchases of property and equipment (cash flow). TTM = FY2025 202.9 + 9M 2026 1,092.2 − 9M 2025 147.9 = 1,147.2. Excludes deposits for future sites (9M26 26.0) and non-cash miner-purchase-liability additions. ÷ 710 MW.
Hut 8.FCF/MW: FY2025 operating cash flow -139.2 − purchases of P&E 202.9 = -342.2 (FY25 10-K cash flow). The old FCF/MW -1.11 × 710 ≈ -788 = -139.2 − 648, using the broader capex figure. ÷ 710 MW.

Nebius.Revenue ($M): TTM Sep 2026 = FY2025 + 9M 2026 − 9M 2025: 529.8 + 1,962.1 − 302.1 = 2,189.8 (FY25 20-F; Q3'26 results release 9M income statement).
Nebius.EBITDA ($M): Company-reported Adjusted EBITDA/(loss). TTM = −64.9 + 831.5 − (−79.9) = 846.5 (FY25 −64.9 per 20-F segment note and Q4'25 release; 9M figures from Q3'26 release reconciliation).
Nebius.PAT ($M): Net income (total, as reported; attributable to Nebius equals total). TTM = FY2025 audited 82.5 + 9M 2026 393.3 − 9M 2025 351.3 = 124.5 (20-F; Q3'26 release). Continuing-ops basis gives the same 124.5 (9.8 + 393.3 − 278.6).
Nebius.Net Debt ($M): At 30 Sep 2026: debt current 187.5 + debt non-current 14,003.3 = 14,190.8, minus cash & cash equivalents 7,425.6 = 6,765.2 (Q3'26 release balance sheet). Same definition as old value (Dec-25: 24.5+4,103.2−3,678.1 = 449.6). Excludes operating leases; restricted cash (1,215.5) not netted.
Nebius.G&A costs ($M): Only 'Sales, general and administrative' is reported (SG&A used). TTM = 380.1 + 555.1 − 218.6 = 716.6 (FY25 20-F income statement; Q3'26 release).
Nebius.Pipeline capacity (MW): Q3'26 shareholder letter: 'We now have more than 4 GW contracted' (contracted power; YE-2026 target 5 GW). Old 2,000 was '>2 GW contracted' (Feb 2026).
Nebius.Total employees: Workforce at 31 Dec 2025, FY25 20-F Item 6.D Employees table (total 1,543: product development 813, SG&A 580, cost of sales 150). No newer figure in 2026 6-Ks.
Nebius.Next FY capex ($M): Q3'26 shareholder letter 2026 guidance: capex 'Approximately $27 billion, above our $20-25 billion range'. FY2027 initial outlook: $40–45B.
Nebius.Customer concentration: Q3'26 interim financial statements, Significant Customers note: 9M 2026 Customer C 20%, D 21%, E 21%; Q3 2026 E 33%, D 22%, C 15%. Customers not named.
Nebius.Capex/MW: Purchases of property and equipment and intangible assets (cash flow). TTM = 4,066.0 + 15,430.7 − 2,010.0 = 17,486.7 (FY25 20-F; Q3'26 release 9M cash flow). ÷ 170 MW.

Meta.EBITDA ($M): Meta reports no adjusted EBITDA. Same proxy as old FY2025 value (101,892 = op. income 83,276 + D&A 18,616): TTM op. income 83,276 + 54,635 - 58,531 = 79,380; TTM D&A (cash-flow statement) 18,616 + 19,509 - 13,205 = 24,920; EBITDA = 104,300.
Meta.PAT ($M): TTM net income = 60,458 + 52,481 - 37,690 = 75,249 (FY25 10-K; Sep-26 10-Q). Total net income (no NCI).
Meta.Net Debt ($M): At 30 Sep 2026: long-term debt 80,922 + long-term debt, current 2,747 (in accrued expenses note) = 83,669 total debt - cash & cash equivalents 11,222 = 72,447. Excludes leases and marketable securities (71,227). Meta reports no net-debt figure.
Meta.G&A costs ($M): TTM 'General and administrative' = 12,152 + 23,079 - 8,455 = 26,776 (FY25 10-K; Sep-26 10-Q). Old FY25 value 12,152 is the same line.
Meta.Total employees: Headcount 66,775 at 30 Sep 2026 (Q3-26 earnings release and 10-Q; down 15% YoY after ~8,000 May-2026 reduction).
Meta.Next FY capex ($M): FY2026 capex guidance (incl. finance-lease principal) narrowed to $135-145B in Q3-26 release (prior $130-145B; old value 137,500 was that midpoint); midpoint 140,000. No numeric 2027 guidance given.
Meta.Capex/MW: TTM capex incl. principal payments on finance leases (Meta's capex definition; matches old FY25 72,215 = 69,691 + 2,524): purchases of PP&E 69,691 + 83,055 - 48,308 = 104,438; finance-lease principal 2,524 + 2,769 - 1,770 = 3,523; total 107,961. Purchases of PP&E only = 104,438. ÷ 3000 MW.
